items.title: U.S. chip stocks extend losses on AI financing, China competition fears
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. chip stocks extended losses in premarket trading Tuesday, building on Monday’s declines after a broad selloff swept through Asian semiconductor names overnight as investors pulled back from AI-linked stocks amid growing worries about how the industry’s infrastructure buildout is being financed and rising competitive pressure from China.

items.title: Why Sandisk (SNDK) Is Down 8.1% After CXMT’s Blockbuster Shanghai IPO Intensifies Competition Concerns
items.summary: Earlier this week, Sandisk came under pressure after the blockbuster Shanghai IPO of Chinese memory maker CXMT intensified worries about future competition in global memory and AI-related chip markets. Although CXMT currently focuses on DRAM and Sandisk on NAND flash, investor concern that China could soon target NAND raised fresh questions about the durability of Sandisk’s profit margins and industry position.
